text: Yaourt Malo is made by the Laiterie de Saint-Malo (SIREN 895780377, SAS, 9 rue du Clos du Noyer, Saint-Malo), whose Président de SAS is SILL Entreprises (SIREN 636220220) with Henri León — of the founding León family — as Directeur Général; the Malo brand therefore sits inside the same family-owned SILL federation (Falc'hun and León families since 1962). No state or sovereign-fund stake was found in the chain.
short: The Malo dairy is chaired by SILL Entreprises, the Falc'hun/León family federation.
